name: USD.AI
oneLiner: USDai is USD.AI's non-yielding base dollar, backed 1:1 by PYUSD and separately stakeable into sUSDai for GPU-loan yield.
collateral: PYUSD held by the canonical USDai contract on Arbitrum and reconciled 1:1 against canonical plus bridged USDai liabilities; GPU-loan DEAL exposure belongs to the separate sUSDai yield layer
pegMechanism: Users mint and redeem canonical USDai against PYUSD through the Arbitrum hub. Satellite USDai supply is tracked as bridgedSupply against the same PYUSD pool, while sUSDai separately deploys deposited USDai into GPU-backed credit strategies.

mechanismArchetypeReview.reviewer: SONG-5 Safety Score V9 mechanism review
mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: USD.AI's PYUSD backing disclosure and fixed-block reconciliation support the fiat-cash classification, but do not disclose current USDai claim, custody-continuity, and independent assurance semantics for the reserve mechanism.
